index_line: - [[ascend-acoustics-cbm-170-se2]] — 8 Ω rated but 3.4 Ω min (effectively-4ohm), LW ±1.8 dB, f3 62 Hz, pref 5.7 (ASR)
brand_notes: US maker (Orange County, CA), sells direct, hand assembled, 30-day guarantee, 7-yr warranty on Sierra line. Bought a Klippel NFS in 2021 and now tunes designs 'NFS optimized' (V2 generation: CBM-170SE2, Sierra-1 V2, Sierra-LX, Sierra-2EX V2, Luna V2). Earlier Ascend speaker measured poorly at ASR (Amir, per asr-ascend-acoustics-sierra-1-v2). Maker publishes Klippel data; in-room sensitivity claims run 4-6 dB above anechoic measurements. Original Sierra-2 and Luna Mini-Monitor are discontinued (replaced by 2EX V2 and Luna V2).
takeaways: ASR Klippel: LW ±1.8 dB, f3 62 Hz, sensitivity 86.5 dB, very wide horizontal dispersion (144 deg).
Impedance minimum 3.4 Ω near 218 Hz despite 8 Ω rating: flagged effectively-4ohm.
THD graph-read about 1.0 % at 86 dB and about 2 % at 96 dB above 100 Hz.
No user reports or other critic reviews found.
conflicts: Impedance 8 Ω rated vs ~3.4 Ω measured
